name: CZ-332
description: An inventory droid, CZ-332 worked at Farlander's Outfitting and Supply, an equipment store and pawn shop on the Wheel space station, which was open around the year 1 BBY during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It worked with the shop's owner, a Human named Nols, in selling a wide range of both new and used equipment.
